title: Top Boy
hook: How does Top Boy end? Dushane and Sully's final betrayal, the ten million stolen pounds, and Stefan in the car park, the series finale explained in full.

sections.heading: Where the final season leaves Dushane and Sully
sections.body: The last season opens with the old partnership already broken. After Sully killed Jamie, he forced Dushane to give up leadership of the Summerhouse operation, taking over himself alongside his associate Junior. Dushane steps back and pours his energy into building Shelley's business. As the new boss, Sully strikes an uneasy alliance with the Irish gang leader Jonny McGee and his uncle Tadgh, who have wiped out the Moroccan suppliers. The two men who built the empire together now circle each other, trust gone, each waiting for the other to move first.

sections.heading: The key turn: money, theft and revenge
sections.body: Dushane discovers that Lizzie and her accountant Lithe have stolen roughly ten million pounds from his accounts, and in his rage and desperation he kills Lizzie's husband Jeffrey. His obsession with the money poisons everything, and Shelley finally ends their relationship. The fatal break with Sully comes over product: Dushane steals drugs that had already been stolen from Sully. For Sully, who has spent the series treating loyalty as the only law worth keeping, this is the final betrayal, and it sets up the killing the whole saga has been building toward.

sections.heading: What the final confrontation means
sections.body: Sully shoots Dushane dead, ending the central friendship of the series on the most brutal terms. There is no reconciliation, no shared exit, just one founder executing the other over stolen product and broken trust. But the violence does not stop there. Sully himself is then shot in the back of the head by an unknown assailant in a car park, killed almost immediately after he settled his score with Dushane. The empire they fought over claims both of them within moments of each other.

sections.heading: The final scene and thematic payoff
sections.body: The closing sequence shows Stefan, Jamie's youngest brother, confronting Sully in a park, holding him at gunpoint over Jamie's death. In the end Stefan decides vengeance is not worth it and lowers the weapon, choosing to step off the cycle of retaliation. Moments later Sully is shot anyway by someone unseen, leaving both the killer's identity and the meaning deliberately ambiguous. Top Boy ends by insisting the road always ends the same way: the game devours everyone who runs it, and the only escape is to refuse to pick up the gun.

final_image: Sully lies dead in a car park, shot by an unseen assailant just after Stefan chose to spare him, the identity of the shooter left a mystery as the series cuts away.

lingering_questions.q: Who kills Dushane in Top Boy?
lingering_questions.a: Sully shoots Dushane dead. The final break comes after Dushane steals drugs that had already been stolen from Sully, which Sully treats as an unforgivable betrayal of the partnership they built together.

lingering_questions.q: Who shoots Sully at the end of Top Boy?
lingering_questions.a: It is left deliberately ambiguous. After Stefan chooses not to kill him, Sully is shot in the back of the head by an unknown assailant in a car park, and the series ends without revealing who pulled the trigger.
